items.cite: Charles Rosen, *The Classical Style: Haydn, Mozart, Beethoven*, expanded edition (W. W. Norton, 1998 paperback).
items.note: Explains musical conventions through Haydn, Mozart and Beethoven; the expanded edition includes a chapter on late Beethoven.

items.cite: William E. Caplin, *Classical Form: A Theory of Formal Functions for the Instrumental Music of Haydn, Mozart, and Beethoven* (Oxford University Press, 1998).
items.note: Analyses the functions of phrases, themes and larger formal units, developing ideas from Schoenberg and Erwin Ratz.

items.cite: Simon P. Keefe, ed., *The Cambridge History of Eighteenth-Century Music* (Cambridge University Press, 2009).
items.note: Organised around music for church, theatre and concert room, rather than a succession of composer biographies.
